copy.curiosityHook: Her new vision was supposed to restore her life, but whose terrifying memories are lingering behind her eyes?
copy.description: After receiving a cornea transplant to regain her sight, a blind violinist begins seeing restless spirits, driving her to uncover the history of the organ and the fate of its former host.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful horror that balances ghostly unease with an engaging, tragic mystery best experienced alone.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Oxide and Danny Pang, this cross-regional Asian horror combines chilling supernatural imagery with an emotionally grounded search for truth.

allowedMaterial: Violinist protagonist regaining sight via cornea transplant
Protagonist seeing ghosts through new eyes
Initial quest to trace cornea origin and donor fate
excludedMaterial: Identity or specific tragedy of the donor discovered later
Any later plot twists, climax events, or ending
